\begin{abstract}
Problem: estimate regional demand and compare candidate forecasts.
Method: use a moving-average baseline and a regression comparison.
Result: the northern region demand remains stable while RMSE is 0.82.
Conclusion: the model supports conservative inventory planning for northern region demand.
\end{abstract}

Figure fig_forecast_trend shows the stable regional forecast trend and supports claim_forecast_stability.
The baseline method is supported by \cite{smith2024baseline}.
